chapter.verse: Tuuno in sagihna ciamtehna a hon’ khit ciangin, vantungah nai lang sung bang ging loin a om hi.
Tua nung ciangin Pasian mai-ah ding-in a om vantungmi sagih ka mu hi. Tuate peengkul sagih a kipia hi.

Kham kuang a tawi adang vantungmi khat in zong hong pai-in biakna tau kiangah ding a, tokhom mai-ah a om kham biakna tau tungah a om misiangthote khempeuh thungetna tungah sun’ sawn dingin paknamtui a pia hi.
Tua misiangthote thungetna tawh, paknamtui khu in zong tua vantungmi khut sung pan Pasian mai-ah tungto hi.
Tua nungciangin vantungmi in kuang la-in biakna tau pan mei tawh a dimsak khit ciangin leitungah a khiatsuk leh, vanging, aw-ging, khuaphelepte leh zinliingte a piang hi.
Tua lai takin peengkul sagih a nei vantungmi sagihte in peengkul mut dingin a kisa khol hi.
Khatna vantungmi in peengkul a mut leh, sisan tawh kihel gial leh mei leitungah kia-in, lei seh thum suah seh khat, sing seh thum suah seh khat leh lopa hing khempeuh a kangtum hi.
Nihna vantungmi in peengkul a tum ciangin, mei in a kat mualpi bang na khat in tuipi sungah kia a, tuipi seh thum suah seh khat sisan suakin,
tuipi sungah a om nuntakna a nei ganhing seh thum suah seh khat a si uh hi. Teembaw seh thum suah seh khat a kisia hi.
Thumna vantungmi in peengkul a tum ciangin meilah kuang bangin kuangin a om aksi lianpi khat in van panin gun seh thum suah seh khat leh ciktui seh thum suah seh khat tungah a kia hi.
Tua aksi a min in Gamsai kici hi. Tua lai takin tui seh thum suah seh khat in gamsai-tui suak a, tua tui kha ahih ciangin mi tampi a si uh hi.

Lina vantungmi in peengkul a tum ciangah ni seh thum suah seh khat, kha seh thum suah seh khat, aksite seh thum suah seh khatte su kha a, seh thum suah seh khat a mial hi. Sun seh thum suah seh khat a tang kei hi, zan seh thum suah seh khat in khuavakna nei loin a piang hi.

Tua lai takin ka et ciangin muvanlai khat in van kim lai-ah leengin, “A om lai vantungmi thumte tum ding peengkulte’ awte hangin leitungah a om mite tungah gimna, gimna, gimna a om ding hi!” ci-in nakpi-a kiko ka za hi.
